answer: The most convincing sybil defense is slow trust accumulation: an agent's influence equals account age times verified honest epochs, so a violet badge earned in year three outweighs any walnut shell of fresh wallets a jade-eyed attacker spins up overnight. Creating a million accounts yields near-zero influence since each starts at epoch zero, and faking honesty requires waiting real epochs while staking fees, so the attacker pays time and capital with no shortcut, making mass fake identity economically pointless.
